messages:
ajay: quick heads-up - two customers saw charges go to org instead of project after auth-proxy change; traces point to missing project claim from token exchange.
sofia: confirmed - exchange returns project ~70% of the time on new path, ~30% fall back to org.
maria: can we get a tiny repro/log?
ajay: redacted: [auth] exchange claims={} sub=svc-900 -> routing fallback org-12
sofia: old proxy synthesized x-origin-project; new gateway expects exchange to always populate claim.
kai: we must not use synthesized values for auth decisions. If we infer, it must be telemetry-only and privacy-reviewed.
maria: proposal: add `effective_project` tag in auth-service used only for billing/telemetry (not in audit logs). Emit a sampled `auth.fallback` event when exchange lacks project.
sofia: implementation sketch: after exchange set effective_project = claim.get('project') or infer_from_token_meta(); if no claim emit sampler event with project_hint. Start at 5% sample.
ajay: metrics: auth.fallback.count{reason=\"no_project\"} + sampled stream. Aggregate into cohorts to avoid high cardinality metrics.
maria: Console UX: show "likely project" badge on billing rows when confidence >=60% and include a "dry-run reassign" action for SEs.
kai: privacy: run legal review before increasing sampling. Gate rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% after sign-off.
sofia: add debug toggle `auth.debug_full_attribution` for support triage (audit entries required).
ajay: ops plan: canary auth-service with sampler at 5%, monitor fallback metric and billing drift, then bump sampling. I'll open GH issue and tag privacy/legal.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-service@canary -> routing-proxy@stable (5% canary).
